reference_sql:
SELECT order_month,
       SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur,
       SUM(CASE WHEN parent_category = 'Gaming' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS gaming_revenue_eur
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
GROUP BY order_month

solver.query:
SELECT order_month, COALESCE(SUM(net_revenue_eur), 0) AS revenue_eur,
       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN parent_category = 'Gaming' THEN net_revenue_eur END), 0) AS gaming_revenue_eur
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
GROUP BY order_month
